## HEADLINE VERDICTS

1. **The 3.01x graph-node delta is explained**: the tree causal-conv is a Python torch-op emulation inside the captured forward — ~95 (chain5) / ~124 (cat9) device nodes PER GDN LAYER vs native's single `causal_conv1d_update` node, ×48 layers ⇒ **~+5,040 (chain5) / ~+6,400 (cat9) captured nodes per verify forward** (est). Single largest block = the per-node conv state write-back loop (~44% of extra).
2. **The wall-time tax is mostly NOT those nodes** (consistent with the banked no-tree-GDN-fallback 1.347x bound ⇒ captured GDN section ≈ 10 ms/fwd). NEW measured evidence (CPU-only re-mining of the banked Nsight sqlite, decode steady-state window): **chain5's main thread is blocked inside synchronous DtoH `cudaMemcpyAsync` 11.45 s of the 12.49 s window (91.7%)**; native main-thread memcpy block = 0.06 s (native waits on the side output thread via `cudaEventSynchronize` = async run-ahead intact). The CPU committer (`_lumo_tree_path_lcp_max_greedy_sample`, 6× `.cpu().tolist()` at `scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:4088-4098`) converts every ms of committer/replay/runner/drafter Python into GPU idle on the critical path. Median eager gap sync-end→next-graph-launch = **4.71 ms/event**; chain5 29.53 ms per graph launch vs native 21.02 (1.405x — matches the 1.39-1.41x s/fwd class).
3. **Drafter census**: tree drafter runs the SAME 5 forwards as native (9 nodes come from top-2 packing, `scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:7410-7425`), but per step it calls `compute_logits` + `topk(152k,2)` AND `_greedy_sample` — which recomputes logits (live vLLM `eagle.py:378-382`) ⇒ **+5 lm_head GEMMs + 5 vocab-wide topk per spec event** (est 6-12 ms/fwd on the 273 GB/s-bound GB10; lm_head ≈ 152k×2048 bf16 ≈ 0.62 GB read each).

## TOP-3 INTERVENTIONS (all estimates labeled; all gated by the lossless gate: B=1 same-seed byte-identical repeat, served streams byte-identical pre/post change at greedy AND temp 0.6, accept/event exactly unchanged, regular decode pristine)

1. **De-serialize the committer (restore async run-ahead)** — GPU-resident committer or async-CPU variant (one packed DtoH; device-side flag asserts replacing 96 `.item()`s; one batched replay launch; pinned HtoD staging). Expected: recovers the unattributed residual, **est 35-60 ms/fwd** of the 86 ms gap (measured basis: 92% main-thread block + 4.7 ms median eager gap + drafter-loop serialization). Node delta: 0. NEEDS GPU EXPERIMENT (highest care: committer is the lossless-critical component — longest-LCP, `FR13_TREE_BONUS_SELF`, REQKEY publishes).
2. **Drafter single-logits fix** — one `compute_logits` + one `topk(2)` per step; spine token = top1 (drop the second lm_head inside `_greedy_sample` and the separate argmax). Expected **est 6-12 ms/fwd**; trivial diff; MUST byte-check argmax-vs-topk tie semantics via the gate. Node delta: 0 (eager). NEEDS 1 GPU boot A/B.
3. **Fuse the tree-conv emulation into one Triton tree-conv kernel** (sibling of `_tree_gdn_kernel`; minimum viable: init-time static index tensors + vectorized write-back). Expected **~-4,300 (chain5) / -5,600 (cat9) captured nodes ≈ 75-80% of the 3.01x delta**, cudaGraphLaunch API 71→~30 µs, wall **est 3-8 ms/fwd** (upper-bounded ≤10 ms by the no-tree-GDN discriminator). Numerics: exact bf16 tap order/cast boundaries (class 10 byte A/B) + class-6 capture safety. NEEDS GPU EXPERIMENT.

Honorable mentions (cheap, byte-gated): delete the redundant out self-copy `:3159` (-48 nodes), hoist per-layer aranges/casts (-~480 nodes), all-layer batched flag validation.

## PURE-SPINE FAST PATH (findings path #2) — INFERIOR TO THE ABOVE

Mechanics: `Tree.is_single_spine()` (`fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:40`) dispatch at the conv branch (`:797`→native `causal_conv1d_update`), scan branch (`:2241`→native `fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update`), committer (chain LCP ≡ native greedy). Breaks/risks: (a) replay contract — native-path events leave ring/flags unstaged, committer must skip replay per-row and trust native's in-kernel linear publish; (b) mixed B>1 batches can't split a captured graph per row ⇒ engages only all-chain batches = a second captured graph family; (c) bonus-row semantics (tree self-target vs native bonus row) coincide only on chains and must be proven byte-identical or it changes WHICH tokens commit (rejected as a speed change); (d) memory `feedback_no_reroute_reward_hacking`: chain5 is only a discriminator — cat9/production trees can never take this path, so it does not converge the deliverable. The same wall tax is removable topology-independently by interventions 1-3, which also fix cat9.

(1) per-phase NVTX/Event attribution (flag-gated, default OFF) to bind intervention-1's estimate; (2) drafter single-logits A/B; (3) conv-fusion byte A/B + ladder; (4) async/GPU committer prototype behind a flag. Speed basis: `request_decode_time_seconds_sum / spec_decode_num_drafts_total` only.
